texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SELVA_ATACANTE_1: Jungle closes in on every side, and the swamps by the river swallow men to the knee. Keep to the tracks and the clearings; the river can only be crossed at the bridges.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SELVA_ATACANTE_2: The trading post stands in its clearing at the river mouth. Take it and hold it.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SELVA_DEFENSOR_1: The enemy must cut his way through the jungle. Let the swamps and the river break up his columns.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SELVA_DEFENSOR_2: Hold the trading post by the river mouth. Whoever holds it holds the river and its trade.
